level.title: Fundamentals
level.description: Reading notes and rhythms, keys and scales, intervals and triads, and the basic vocabulary of music.

unit.title: Staff, Clefs and Note Names
unit.summary: Read notes in the treble and bass clefs, with ledger lines.

unit.title: Note Values and Rests
unit.summary: Whole, half, quarter, eighth and sixteenth notes, dots and rests.

unit.title: Beat and Time Signatures
unit.summary: Pulse, bars, simple and compound time.

unit.title: Accidentals, Half Steps and Whole Steps
unit.summary: Sharps, flats and naturals on the staff and on the keyboard.

unit.title: Major Scales and Keys
unit.summary: The major scale, key signatures and the circle of fifths.

unit.title: Minor Scales and Keys
unit.summary: Natural, harmonic and melodic minor; relative and parallel keys.

unit.title: Intervals
unit.summary: Number and quality of intervals, on the staff and by ear.

unit.title: Scale Degrees
unit.summary: The names and functions of the degrees of a key.

unit.title: Triads
unit.summary: Major, minor, diminished and augmented triads and their inversions.

unit.title: Tempo, Dynamics and Articulation
unit.summary: The Italian terms and signs that tell how to perform music.
